sentences.text: Shri Hemant Sen, counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Narendra Chourasiya, Government Advocate for the respondent/State.
Heard on admission.
Admit.
Call for the record of the Courts below.
Learned Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of respondent/State, as such, no further notice is required.
Heard on IA.No.13305/2018 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner Bachcha Yadav.

A perusal of the impugned judgment reveals that petitioner stands convicted under Sections 16(1)(d)(i) and 16(1)(d)(ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo effective rigorous imprisonment for a period of 6 months and fine in the sum of Rs.1500/-, with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been in custody since the date of the judgment of the appellate Court i.e. 26.07.2018; therefore, it has been prayed that the application be allowed and petitioner be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State has opposed the application.

sentences.text: However, keeping in view the quantum of sentence imposed upon the petitioner and the period already undergone by him, he deserves to be released on bail.
Consequently, this application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner Bachcha Yadav, is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount and furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Bachcha Y Adav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61520744/
1 Rs.40,000/- with one solvent surety in the same amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 15.01.2019 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this behalf, the substantive jail sentence imposed upon petitioner shall stand suspended and he shall be released on bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
